basic_info.description: Pristine and elegant condominium in a rose-covered French Mediterranean building designed by renowned architect Henry Gutterson in the heart of Pacific Heights. Residence A is a 3-bedroom, 3-bath, architectural gem. It is flooded with natural light and replete with romantic Edwardian details, including high coved ceilings, archways, hardwood floors, and French doors. The interior has been thoughtfully renovated throughout w/high-end finishes. A grand living room with a marble fireplace is adjacent to a generous formal dining room. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with marble counters, deluxe appliances, and a breakfast bar. 3 bedrooms boast ensuite marble baths and 2 bedrooms overlook the building's private, gorgeous rose garden. The residence includes in-unit laundry, deeded garage parking, and large private storage. This boutique elevator building offers a lush, shared garden and is on a flat block, walking distance to the shops & fine dining on Union.
